jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Montu UK’s mission is to make high-quality, plant-based therapies easier to access, while setting new standards in safety, clinical excellence and patient experience so that many more people can benefit from personalised treatment options. As Product Manager, you will work across business functions to specify and deliver software solutions which sustain Montu UK's rapid growth, while maintaining an unswerving focus on the quality of our patient-care. You will recognise opportunities to innovate, aligning strategy with the day to day requirements of our internal teams. You will work across every aspect of the business, from patient engagement to dispensing and dispatch. You will interact with stakeholders at every level, collating their insights and expertise to generate a roadmap which drives the business forward. Embedded within the engineering team, you will collaborate with a small group of gifted and supportive developers, UX, and Product specialists. Collectively, we deliver quality technical solutions at a rapid pace. About the Role Product Leadership Strategic Roadmap Ownership: Devise, maintain and represent the product roadmap, ensuring its alignment with strategic objectives, stakeholder needs, and the needs of our rapidly growing patient and operational base. Prioritisation: Drive the prioritisation of product features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on business value, user needs, strategic objectives, and risk. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Foster a supportive, collaborative, and results-oriented culture within the dedicated engineering, UX, and Product team, ensuring seamless execution and continuous improvement. Engagement & Influence Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the organisation; including marketing, operations, clinical services, pharmacy and executive leadership . Effective Communication & Influence: Develop and deliver clear, compelling product strategies, roadmaps, and progress

jobs.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system. What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d): German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing. Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably. Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design. Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later. Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs. Produc

jobs.description: At Cogstate , we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life. Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials. Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving. At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it. That’s why we’re seeking a Coordinator, Rater Services responsible for supporting multiple operational activities and functional areas to ensure the successful delivery of Cogstate's Rater Services programs and clinical trial support activities. The Coordinator, Rater Services will provide flexible, cross-functional support across a variety of service areas and serve as a key point of coordination between internal teams, study stakeholders, and external customers. jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.
